items.lede: Around 265,000 customers potentially affected as London transport operator grapples with another security breach
items.title: TfL takes Oyster photocard website offline after attackers compromise customer accounts

items.lede: Transport for London (TfL) has announced that around 265,000 Oyster photocard customers may have had their account details exposed in a data breach. [...]
